title: hotfix: SLO enforcer regional failover + load-shedding stabilization
author: Ethan Chen
description:
Context: During a regional capacity event we observed the SLO enforcer flip into an aggressive load-shedding state when the primary region failed over. Symptoms included sustained shedding rates in the previously healthy region, delayed backoff recovery, and an ordering/atomicity bug that allowed partially-applied threshold updates to persist across in-memory shards. This caused customer-facing 429s to spike for low-latency routes during the failover window.

Root cause: Two issues combined: 1) threshold update ordering in pkg/slo/enforcer/thresholds.go allowed a transient state where a shard saw lowered backoff_hysteresis without the paired quorum flag, leading to repeated shedding decisions; 2) the regional-failover path applied policy changes asynchronously to avoid latency, but did not wait for confirmation when failover was rapid, which left different regions with mismatched canary config.

What this PR does (summary):
- Fix ordering and atomic update path in pkg/slo/enforcer/thresholds.go so threshold and hysteresis changes are applied atomically to in-memory shards.
- Add a short-circuit during regional failover to prefer conservative thresholds for the first 30s after switchover (configurable via charts/slo-enforcer/values.yaml).
- Tweak default load-shedding ramp parameters to prevent thrashing under repeated failovers.
- Add end-to-end e2e test covering regional failover + aggressive traffic pattern (tests/slo-enforcer/e2e/regional_failover_test.go).
- Add new metrics and dashboards: slo_enforcer.shed_rate, slo_enforcer.threshold_apply_latency, slo_enforcer.failover_hysteresis_active.
- Update runbook and postmortem template references in docs/runbooks/slo-enforcer.md.

Backwards compatibility and safety: Changes are conservative defaults; cluster-wide config remains mutable. No API changes. Default behavior is slightly more conservative (less aggressive shedding) to prioritize availability during failover windows.

Checklist:
- [x] Fix implemented and unit-tested
- [x] e2e covering failover+shedding added
- [x] Metrics added and graphed in experimental dashboard
- [x] Runbook updated
- [x] Changelog/release notes drafted

Related: Linear ENG-5491 tracks epic to harden SLO enforcer; this PR is a hotfix backport of the stabilization portion. See incident timeline in the postmortem link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-5491/regional-failover-shedding-incident
